_comment: Demand model for the nmvn prebuilt-binary catalog: language=java, Spring Boot 4.1.0.
A FEATURE is a set of plugin realms that appear together and are triggered by the same
start.spring.io dependency. Features are the unit of catalog variation: every generated pom
needs the core set plus some subset of these six, and nothing else. Derived by generating a pom
for all 205 initializr dependencies plus a native-x-dep and kotlin-x-dep interaction sweep, then
running build-nmvn-for-pom.sh --plugins-only on every pom whose <build><plugins> differed.
closureMb is the resolved transitive jar closure (maven-dependency-plugin:copy-dependencies on a
probe pom), which is what a baked realm has to carry. imageMbPerClosureMb converts that to image
growth and is the ONE number here that is a guess -- see calibration note in plan_catalog.py.
prior is P(a generated project needs this feature). These are ESTIMATES. Measured 2026-07-29:
the exact feature grouping they produce is NOT trustworthy (plan_catalog.py --sensitivity: the
k=4 partition survives 4x prior perturbation in only 2/200 draws), but the optimum is flat, so
that does not matter -- plan_catalog.py --regret puts the cost of these guesses at a mean 4.9MB
against a 262MB saving over one universal image. Do NOT wait for telemetry to build the catalog;
do NOT read meaning into which features share a binary.
_core_comment: Both maven-jar-plugin and maven-war-plugin are in core, so <packaging> is NOT a catalog axis:
war-plugin is ~1 MB and carrying both everywhere is cheaper than doubling the catalog.
maven-compiler-plugin being in core is what makes lombok and configuration-processor free --
they add only an explicit compiler-plugin block, and annotationProcessorPaths are not plugin
<dependencies>, so PrebuiltPluginRealms.match() sees an unchanged dependency key.

jpa-native._comment: hibernate-maven-plugin appears ONLY for native + data-jpa together; data-jpa alone does not add it.

unbakeable._comment: Both carry <extensions>true</extensions>, which gets a structurally different realm; build-nmvn-for-pom.sh skips them by design. They are excluded from feature detection so they never influence selection.
